name: Wellness Check-In
description: A gentle daily 'I'm OK' check-in for someone living alone. They tap in on their own schedule or at an agreed time, and can ask for a family call. The care circle sees a shared board; when a check-in is missed, a dose goes unlogged or a call is requested, one relative takes it, everyone sees who, and the follow-up is recorded.

profiles.sql: SELECT * FROM app_wellness_check_in__profiles ORDER BY created_at ASC

checkins.sql: SELECT * FROM app_wellness_check_in__checkins ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 200

requests_open.sql: SELECT * FROM app_wellness_check_in__requests WHERE status <> 'done' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 200

requests_handled.sql: SELECT * FROM app_wellness_check_in__requests WHERE status = 'done' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

open_request.title: Ask the care circle to follow up
open_request.description: Put a request on the Wellness Check-In board when something was missed — a dose that went unlogged, a check-in that never came. It stays open until one relative takes it, and everyone else can see who did.

suggested_automations.title: Hand a missed dose to a relative
suggested_automations.description: When a scheduled dose in Medications is still unlogged after its grace window, a request appears on the Wellness Check-In board. One relative takes it and records what happened; everyone else sees it is handled. The event carries no medication name, so neither does the request.

source.query: SELECT id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(label, ''), 'Wellness check-in') AS title, member_id AS member_id, :today AS when_at, CASE WHEN substr(last_checkin_at, 1, 10) = :today THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done FROM app_wellness_check_in__profiles WHERE active = 1 AND (last_checkin_at IS NULL OR last_checkin_at = '' OR substr(last_checkin_at, 1, 10) = :today OR date(last_checkin_at, '+' || interval_hours || ' hours') <= :today) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10

SELECT id AS id, CASE kind WHEN 'call' THEN 'Family call requested' WHEN 'missed_dose' THEN 'Follow up on a missed dose' ELSE 'Follow up on a missed check-in' END AS title, :today AS when_at, 0 AS done, CASE WHEN status = 'claimed' THEN claimed_by ELSE NULL END AS member_id FROM app_wellness_check_in__requests WHERE status <> 'done' AND (opened_on IS NULL OR opened_on <= :today) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_wellness_check_in__profiles WHERE active = 1 AND (last_checkin_at IS NULL OR last_checkin_at = '' OR date(last_checkin_at, '+' || interval_hours || ' hours') <= :today) LIMIT 1
